_doc: Miss Trudy — the legacy store manager of the Lamar megamart, a genuine sweetheart who treats people with real warmth. Forced out of the store by corporate 'early retirement' in Act 2. Dialogue-only.
name: Miss Trudy
title: Legacy Store Manager
samplePhrase: You'll do fine out here, sugar. The people'll tell you the truth if you let 'em.
